actions.title: Run synthesis pass on 396 (ingredient, metal) cells that have 2+ contributing sources
actions.closes_what: ingredient contamination_profile cells move from pending to populated per CLAUDE.md Part 9 incremental-update rules
actions.details: 1587 ingredient × metal cells are currently pending. Of those, 396 have 2+ A-tier sources contributing values per the routing audit and are eligible for initial-population synthesis. The remaining 1191 cells have 0-1 contributing sources and need more corpus before synthesis runs.

actions.title: Recover real DOIs for 92 source pages currently marked no_doi_assigned with Scholar fallback
actions.closes_what: provenance debt from 2026-05-13 publish run (wiki/lint/2026-05-13-doi-fallback-followup.md); restores real DOI + publisher access URLs in place of Scholar search fallbacks
actions.best_dispatched_to: Claude Code Opus (small structured edits, occasional DOI lookup)
actions.details: Each page has its raw_path pointing to the Marker-converted markdown. DOI is usually on page 1 of the paper; if not, query Crossref / OpenAlex / Semantic Scholar by title+author+year. Replace doi: null + no_doi_assigned: true + Scholar URL with the real DOI + matching publisher access_url. If no DOI exists after exhaustive search, keep no_doi_assigned: true but replace the Scholar URL with a venue/publisher URL.

actions.title: Populate 314 *[awaiting synthesis]* cells in source-legend tables across 173 pages

Autonomous; no Karen review required.

actions.title: Draft missing mandatory sections on 125 non-stub ingredient pages

actions.best_dispatched_to: Claude Code Opus (per-page section drafting from routing audit + source pages)
actions.details: Each page needs the missing sections drafted from the routing audit's contributing sources. Autonomous; no Karen review required. The subprocess reads the page, identifies contributing sources via routing audit, reads the top 3-5 source TL;DRs, drafts each missing section per the Part 6 template, commits in batches of 10-15 pages.
